Vacancies for Faculty
Saturday, 14 March 2015
8118 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts:
Professor in TB & Chest
Associate Professor in Radiotherapy
Assistant Professor in Anesthesiology,  General Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology,  Ophthalmology, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Psychiatry, Radiodiagnosis
Sr. Resident in Anesthesiology, Medicine, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Radiodiagnosis, Surgery, TB & Chest
The applicant should apply along with complete bio-data and necessary academic certificates/testimonials to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS). The applicants may also appear for a walk-in-interview along with the application and supporting documents at 10 A.M. on any working day. The appointments would be adhoc till the Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: As per the Medical Council of India norms.
Pay Scale
Professors/Assistant Professor:  As per rules (6th Pay Commission)
Senior Resident: Consolidated Salary of Rs. 42140/- per month.
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203)  or email at
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
